someoneWhoNoLongerHas: Someone who no longer has access
everyCardAsARow: Every card as a row, a column per field
cardsOnTheDaysOf: Cards on the days of their dates
cardsAsBarsFromStart: Cards as bars from start to due date
addAViewOfThese: Add a view of these cards: a table, list, calendar or timeline (for everyone)
arrangeALinkedViewFor: Arrange a linked view for me
saveALinkedViewFor: Save a linked view for everyone
theEndCanTBe: The end can’t be before the start.
altAndTheArrowKeys: Alt and the arrow keys move it by a day or a week. Enter sets its date.
noCardHasAStartname: No card has a {startName} or {endName} yet: drag one from the side.
thisNounSFilterLeaves: This {noun}’s filter leaves out all {hidden} cards.
noCardsYetCardsOn: No cards yet. Cards on {value} show here as rows.
thisNounSFilterLeaves2: This {noun}’s filter leaves out every card.
noCardsYetCardsOn2: No cards yet. Cards on {value} show here as a list.
linkedToTheKanbanTitle: Linked to the kanban “{title}”: show it
theKanbanIsLockedIts: The kanban is locked: its cards are read only here
thisViewIsLockedIts: This view is locked: its cards are read only here
openTheKanbanInFocus: Open the kanban in focus mode: all its cards as a page you arrange your way
theKanbanThisViewShowed: The kanban this view showed was deleted
undoBringsItBackAnd: Undo brings it back, and this view shows its cards again.
theKanbanThisViewShows: The kanban this view shows was deleted, or is somewhere on the board you can’t see.
dragToChangeTheColumn: Drag to change the column width
openInFocusModeAll: Open in focus mode: all its cards as a list you arrange your way
sortedBySortedbyEachColumn: Sorted by {sortedBy}: each column keeps that order (cards still move between columns)
showEveryCardInThis: Show every card in this column
nMoreCardsInThis: {n} more cards in this column: open in focus mode
linkedViewsStayOnThe: Linked views stay on the board of their kanban for now: copy the kanban itself to take its cards along.
cardsTheSavedFilterHides: Cards the saved filter hides stay hidden.
saveForEveryoneToHide: Save for everyone to hide them on the board.
yourFilterFadesTheCards: Your filter fades the cards it leaves out, for you only.{value}{value2}
aFilterYouSetHere: A filter you set here fades the other cards for you only, until it is saved for everyone.
cardsAreInTheOrder: Cards are in the order people put them. Sorting moves them for everyone.
itWasDeletedOrYou: It was deleted, or you can no longer see it.
yourFilterLeavesOutEvery: Your filter leaves out every card.
thisKanbanHasNoCards: This kanban has no cards yet.
arrangedYourWayOnlyYou: Arranged your way: only you see how.
changesToCardsAreSaved: Changes to cards are saved for everyone.
youCanReadEveryCard: You can read every card here.
dateFieldTheCalendarPlaces: Date field the calendar places cards on
leavesCardsOutOfThis: Leaves cards out of this page, for you only. The board doesn’t change.
hereForYouOnlyThe: here, for you only. The cards stay where they are on the board.
chooseWhatItsCardsShow: Choose what its cards show and how they are coloured.
lockedByLockedbyTheView: Locked by {lockedBy}: the view stays as saved. You can still change it for yourself.
groupingMovesTheCardsOn: Grouping moves the cards on the board, so it changes for everyone. A single select, person or checkbox field can make the columns or the rows.
theViewIsLockedIts: The view is locked: its grouping stays as saved.
theBoardSEditorsChoose: The board’s editors choose how its cards are grouped.
densityChangesCardSizesFor: Density changes card sizes for everyone.
densityIsSetByThe: Density is set by the board’s editors.
everyoneSeesThisNounYour: Everyone sees this {noun}. Your changes stay yours until you save them.
changesYouMakeHereAre: Changes you make here are yours alone.
itsKanbanIsnTOn: Its kanban isn’t on the board
itWasDeletedUndoBrings: It was deleted. Undo brings it back.
itWasDeletedOrIs: It was deleted, or is somewhere on the board you can’t see.
name: Name
draggingACardToA: Dragging a card to a day sets this date. A date field of the kanban works too.
altOnARowMoves: Alt + ↑ / ↓ on a row moves the card to the group above or below.
leavesNounOutOfThis: Leaves {noun} out of this {scope} only: the board and its cards don’t change.
withoutASortBarsAre: Without a sort, bars are in order of their start.
ordersTheCardsWithinEach: Orders the cards within each day.
withoutASortRowsFollow: Without a sort, rows follow the board: column by column, top to bottom.
aKanbanKeepsAtLeast: A kanban keeps at least one column
stageCanBeRenamedNot: Stage can be renamed, not deleted
itsOptionsAreTheBoard: Its options are the board’s columns: a card’s value is the column it is in.
theBoardIsGroupedBy: The board is grouped by it: a card’s value is the column it is in.
itsFieldsShowHereWhat: Its fields show here: what every card on it can hold, like a priority, an owner or points.
thisKanbanIsLockedUnlock: This kanban is locked: unlock it to change its fields.
altAndTheLeftOr: Alt and the left or right arrow moves it a day; with Shift too, its end. Enter sets its dates.
theSavedFilterHidesCards: The saved filter hides cards it leaves out from everyone; they still count toward WIP limits.
sortingMovesTheCardsFor: Sorting moves the cards for everyone. Cards still move between columns; back to manual order puts every card where it was.
changesTheViewForEveryone: Changes the view for everyone. Its filter and sort stay; edits in it change the kanban’s real cards.
draggingABarMovesBoth: Dragging a bar moves both dates; dragging an end changes that one.
